meta.title: Nisshkaa Bhanshaly — Architecture & Photography
meta.description: Portfolio of Nisshkaa Bhanshaly — third-year architecture student and photographer. Buildings, drawings, models, and the built world through a camera.

hero.tagline: A third-year architecture student who builds space by hand, in models and in 3D — and reads the built world through a camera.

intro.leadHtml: I design buildings the slow way — pencil first, then models I can hold, then drawings and 3D. And I photograph the built world the way I read it: light, geometry, and the marks people leave on it. One eye, two crafts.

photography.heading: Field journal
photography.intro: Not documentation — an archive of how I see. Each frame is a place and a moment.

about.lead: I'm Nisshkaa — a third-year architecture student who believes a building is only as good as the thinking you can see behind it.
about.body: I work across hand drawing, technical drafting, physical model-making and digital 3D, and I photograph architecture wherever I travel. The camera keeps my architecture honest; the architecture teaches me how to look. I'm looking for a studio internship where I can keep making — and keep learning.
